candidate_grammar.boundary: Every positive finite FORMX-003 configuration, relation, trace, composition and registered successor boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis FORMX-003 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: FORMX-003 uniquely retains three-way-terminal-recurrence-ledger, complete execution custody, root forcing, post-registry observation and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, imported machine model, theorem answer or target outcome selects the survivor
host absence and artifact counters are not admitted numerical-zero objects
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating or completed-infinite proof scalar
no hidden transition, selected branch, omitted parse, unregistered oracle or stochastic cause
no failed route retires an obligation or changes the protected engine or verification authority
statement: Acceptance and rejection are separately labelled terminal classes; nontermination is a retained recurrent or open execution trace and is never relabelled as either terminal outcome.
title: Acceptance, rejection and nontermination distinction
